# 12 Year Old

![12YO](https://www.jurawhisky.com/media/koukii1w/12yo.png?width=230&height=654&v=1dc1b19e083ab10)

Just like a visit to our island home, this whisky is as unique and rewarding as it is enjoyable. Crafted in our exceptionally tall stills and matured in American white oak ex-Bourbon casks, this Scottish island whisky is a testament to our fruity and balanced house style.

With layers of peach, bright citrus and lightly toasted walnut, Jura 12 Year Old is easy to enjoy and even better shared.

![BG Colour](https://www.jurawhisky.com/media/3cabc4yk/bg-colour.png?width=1920&height=867&v=1dc106519e128c0)
